g.text: Historical PPO checkpoints: throughput on fixed validation data
5 paired loads × 1 validation trace (1,000 requests) per model and seed | Each seed's epoch-0 BC = 100%
Old reward only. Lines connect measured checkpoints; intermediate validation is unavailable. Epoch 2 reset Adam/Torch RNG.
